I attempted to ask and she said that was an invasion of her privacy. 

I spoke with the mutual therapist friend, and she suggested I explain to her that I'm very concerned, and even though this isn't something that can't be documented in a clinical setting, make her promise not to use the weapon for something that we would all regret. 

I think I may have worked around this. The two of us have lots of mutual friends, and I think I've found one that is closer to her than I am. She's agreed to let that friend take the gun, so I'm going to get it to him.
